RefundDetails.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    populateRefundDetails: function(producerValues) {
        var order = new GlideRecord('x_1771422_refund_0_order_details');
        order.addQuery('order_id', producerValues);
        order.query();
        if (order.next()) {
            var refund = {};
            refund.full_name = order.full_name;
            refund.email = order.email;
            refund.contact_no = order.contact_no;
            refund.address = order.address;
            refund.city = order.city;
            refund.state = order.state;
            refund.pin_code = order.pin_code;
			
        }
		return JSON.stringify(refund);
    },
    type: 'RefundDetails'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-07 11:44:10</sys_created_on><sys_id>a123b15683666e105d2db4b6feaad39e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Refund details</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Refundify" source="x_1771422_refund_0">f7ec429d83262a105d2db4b6feaad363</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Refundify">f7ec429d83262a105d2db4b6feaad363</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_a123b15683666e105d2db4b6feaad39e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-07 12:15:01</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
